episodes.title: The Jack-of-All-Trades Becomes a Swordsman Once More
episodes.summary: Cast out of the Hero Party, "jack-of-all-trades" Orhun Dura sets out on a new journey as a solo adventurer!

episodes.title: No Going Back for the Jack-of-All-Trades
episodes.summary: Orhun begins his descent into the dungeon with the new recruits.

episodes.title: The Jack-of-all-Trades Speaks of His Ideals
episodes.summary: The students find an article that says Orhun was fired for being too weak.

episodes.title: The Hero Party Looks Back
episodes.summary: With Orhun gone, the Heroes Party is forced to confront its weakness.

episodes.title: The Jack-of-All-Trades' Bad Feeling Comes True
episodes.summary: The training expedition comes to an end as unexpected disaster looms.

episodes.title: The Jack-of-All-Trades Overcomes His Limits
episodes.summary: Orhun faces the Black Dragon alone.

episodes.title: The Jack-of-All-Trades Follows His Feelings
episodes.summary: Orhun must decide what he'll do with his life now that he's alone.

episodes.title: The Jack-of-All-Trades Fights with Everyone
episodes.summary: Orhun settles into his new role at the Night Sky Silver Rabbits.

episodes.title: The Jack-of-All-Trades Has a Bad Feeling
episodes.summary: Orhun goes on his first dungeon dive with his new party.

episodes.title: The Jack-of-All-Trades Makes Them Train Hard
episodes.summary: Orhun starts to train the new recruits.

episodes.title: The Jack-of-All-Trades Fears for His Friends
episodes.summary: Orhun and Unit 1 begin their attack on the Black Dragon.

episodes.title: The Jack-of-All-Trades Protects His Comrades
episodes.summary: With his students in danger, Orhun is forced to act fast in his battle with the Black Dragon
